newsitem.title: UK: IBCA rates GAN Insurance unit.
newsitem.headline: IBCA rates GAN Insurance unit.

text.p: IBCA, the European rating agency, said on Thursday it had assigned a claims settling ability rating of A (good security) to the GAN Insurance Company Limited (GAN), based in London.
"GAN is a multi-line general insurer writing London Market and UK provincial business," IBCA said in a statement.
IBCA said since 1984 the company, formerly known as the Minster Insurance Co Ltd, had been a wholly-owned part of the state-owned French insurance group Societe Centrale du GAN.
"Its prime source of business is intermediaries but a proportion of personal lines business comes via GAN's direct telephone response subsidiary Touchline Insurance Co Ltd," IBCA said.
IBCA said GAN's financial position had improved. Technical reserves were considered satisfactory and were subject to rigorous scrutiny by the company's actuarial team.

"A careful investment strategy has covered underwriting losses and produced growing profits. Coupled with capital injections, these have increased the solvency margin ratio to 45 percent in 1995, the highest level since 1989," the agency said.
IBCA said the improvement in GAN's position showed the effectiveness of the measures implemented by the new management team.

"In the short run the company continues to rely on investment income for profitability and profits are expected to be lower over the next three years as a Claims Equalisation Reserve is established," IBCA said. "Although the Combined Ratio is unlikely to fall below 100 percent during the current down-turn in the insurance cycle, in IBCA's opinion the strong management team has built a firm foundation for future development."
